using CUDA
using JSON3

function vadd!(y, a, b)
    i = (blockIdx().x - 1) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x
    if i <= length(y); @inbounds y[i] = a[i] + b[i]; end
    return nothing
end

mark(s) = (println(stderr, "MARK: ", s); flush(stderr))

r = Dict{String,Any}()
a_host = Float32[1,2,3,4]; b_host = Float32[10,20,30,40]; n = 4

r["ndevices"] = CUDA.ndevices()
r["visible"]  = get(ENV, "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", "<unset>")
r["driver"]   = string(CUDA.driver_version())
r["runtime"]  = string(CUDA.runtime_version())
r["names"]    = [CUDA.name(d) for d in CUDA.devices()]
mark("env ok, ndevices=$(CUDA.ndevices())")

function launch_here(tag)
    mark("$tag: begin on device $(CUDA.device())")
    ad = CuArray(a_host); bd = CuArray(b_host); yd = CUDA.zeros(Float32, n)
    mark("$tag: arrays allocated")
    @cuda threads=256 blocks=1 vadd!(yd, ad, bd)
    CUDA.synchronize()
    mark("$tag: launch ok")
    return Array(yd)
end

# A: default device, no device! call at all
r["A_default"] = launch_here("A_default")

# B: explicit device!(0)
CUDA.device!(0); mark("B: device!(0) returned")
r["B_dev0"] = launch_here("B_dev0")

# C: switch to device 1
if CUDA.ndevices() > 1
    CUDA.device!(1); mark("C: device!(1) returned")
    r["C_dev1"] = launch_here("C_dev1")
end

# D: switch back
CUDA.device!(0); mark("D: device!(0) again")
r["D_back0"] = launch_here("D_back0")

mark("all steps completed")
println(JSON3.write(Dict("probe" => r)))
